### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 1: Au milieu du chemin de notre vie / À mi parcours de notre existence / Juste au milieu du chemin de notre vie - Line 2: Je me suis retrouve dans une foret sombre / Je me suis perdu dans les bois sombres / Je me suis retrouve au coeur de une foret obscure - Line 3: car le droit chemin était perdu / parce que la voie droite était égarée / puisque le sentier droit était manqué

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into French lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
**Line Inventory:** - Au milieu du chemin de notre vie
**Assembly Notes:** - none (phrase used as‑is)
**Target Text:** Au milieu du chemin de notre vie

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1, Au milieu du chemin de notre vie, At the middle of the road of our life, Midway upon the road of our life, End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Au milieu du chemin de notre vie - Line 2, Je me suis retrouvé dans une forêt sombre,, I found myself in a dark forest, I found myself within a dark wood, End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Je me suis retrouvé dans une forêt sombre, - Line 3, car le droit chemin était perdu., for the right way was lost, for the right way had been missed, End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, car le droit chemin était perdu.
